title: Accept Jev's routing of a feedback item
description: Feedback routing takes Jev's destination for a beta tester's feedback when Jev's confidence is at or above the line. Below it, the fallback decides.

question.text: Is Jev's destination for this feedback item right?

evidence.sensor: Jev (TypeSafe), the client the venture injects

scale.meaning: Jev's confidence in its destination, 0 to 1

note: An accept option passed to route still takes precedence over this line.
